frameworkPrinciples: Every raid attempt is deterministic from stage profile, approach, tier, and one active deity state.
Each stage has a readable tactical problem, preferred-but-not-required counterplay, and explicit carry-forward damage pressure.
Victory rewards are non-pay-to-win: first-clear bonuses, replay caps, mastery credit, and cosmetic/material outputs only.
Live PvP, Deity fanout, paid power shortcuts, and hidden random rolls are forbidden in the initial framework.
raidLoop: Select one active deity and loadout
Preview five Gate Warden stages, tier modifiers, score rules, and non-pay-to-win rewards
Resolve each stage through BALANCED, GUARDED, or AGGRESSIVE approach
Carry score, turn count, damage taken, stage tags, and reaction pressure forward
Lock victory and assign capped raid rewards plus divine mastery credit
Lock victory and assign capped raid rewards plus Deity mastery credit

BALANCED.read: Best default route; strong score without overexposing the active deity.

GUARDED.read: Lower damage and safer carries; costs tempo and top-score ceiling.

AGGRESSIVE.read: Fastest clear; risks damage penalties and asks for confident reaction timing.

stageProfiles.name: Sealfield Approach
stageProfiles.goal: Break the outer seal pillars before rupture lanes compress the approach.
stageProfiles.carryRisk: Low damage, high tempo value. Poor clears reduce later score ceiling.

stageProfiles.name: Guardian Interdiction
stageProfiles.goal: Survive the Gate Warden's guard constructs while holding center access.
stageProfiles.carryRisk: Medium damage. Failed reaction discipline raises mastery cost.

stageProfiles.name: Weakness Window
stageProfiles.goal: Expose the Warden's core by forcing terrain interaction at the right beat.
stageProfiles.carryRisk: Low turn count but high misplay penalty. Drives S-rank eligibility.

stageProfiles.name: Gate Destabilization
stageProfiles.goal: Stabilize collapsing Gate lanes while the boss punishes predictable routes.
stageProfiles.carryRisk: High damage carry. The safest place to spend defensive tempo.

stageProfiles.name: Divine Enrage
stageProfiles.goal: Finish the Warden during Divine pressure before the Gate fully reopens.
stageProfiles.carryRisk: Final damage and turn penalties decide reward quality.

economyTuning.designGoal: Reward clean solo-Deity raid execution without selling power, uncapped repeat currency, or mandatory ownership shortcuts.
antiPayToWinRules: Raid rewards are earned from deterministic clears only.
Replay payout is capped and decays by weekly clear count.
Mastery credit applies only to the one active deity used in the clear.
First-clear rewards are granted once per raid and tier.
acceptanceGates: First clear receives token bonus, Ember, Relics, and one Mastery Seal.
Replay clear receives reduced scalar payout and cannot exceed tier weekly token cap.
S replay can earn at most one Mastery Seal; non-S replays earn none.
Validation fails on paidPowerShortcut, uncappedReplayRewards, or purchasable raid power.

sourceCultureLoadoutRule: Raid loadouts preview each active deity’s source-culture weapon, armor, core, resource, reaction, and execution so raid power never reads as generic gear.
